grammar.title: too + adj. + (for sb.) + to do：太……以至于不能
grammar.explanation: too 后接形容词或副词，表示程度过头。结构本身已含否定意义，不再加 not。中考常考 too...to... 与 so...that...can't 的句型转换。
examples: The title felt too large for him to carry.
He was too nervous to speak.
The silence was too awkward to break.

grammar.title: as if / as though：仿佛，好像
grammar.explanation: 引导方式状语从句，表示比喻或推测。若与现在事实相反，从句可用过去式（虚拟语气）。写作中可增加生动感。
examples: Barney spoke as if reading from a mutual script.
Robin smiled as though a weight had lifted.
Ted looked as if he had seen a ghost.

grammar.title: refuse / reluctant + to do：不愿做某事
grammar.explanation: refuse to do 表示明确拒绝；reluctant to do 表示不情愿。两者后都接动词原形，是高频搭配。
examples: Barney and Robin refused to define what they were.
Robin was reluctant to admit anything deeper.
Ted refused to give up.

grammar.explanation: had + 过去分词，表示在主线之前已完成。
examples: Marshall had found a man who looked like him.
Only Ted had not found his.
Lily had spotted a redhead.

grammar.title: the only one + 定语从句：唯一一个
grammar.explanation: 强调唯一，后接 who/that 引导的从句。
examples: He was the only one who had not found his lookalike.
She was the only one that knew.
He was the only one who stayed.

grammar.title: be about to do：正要做
grammar.explanation: 表示即将发生的动作。
examples: The search was about to end.
He was about to leave.
They were about to start a new life.

grammar.title: as if + 从句：仿佛
grammar.explanation: 引导方式状语从句，可表虚拟。
examples: The man stared back, as if destiny had played a joke.
He looked as if he had seen a ghost.
She smiled as if nothing had happened.

grammar.title: be the universe's way of saying：是老天在说
grammar.explanation: 生动表达，表示某种现象的深意。
examples: Coincidences were the universe's way of saying no one was alone.
Silence was her way of saying no.
Tears were his way of showing love.
